prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='ARIMA', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ARIMA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) and best seasonality correlation (0.5903), but has catastrophic RMSE (571.43) due to systematic bias. The actual best performers are ONLY_FT_catboost (RMSE=36.92) and ONLY_DWT_rf (RMSE=39.05), which balance trend/seasonality capture with low error. High rmse_spread_ratio (26.76) and concept drift detected suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition while handling disagreement and drift.
